scenario.title: The Borrowed Road
scenario.summary: An invented ancient crisis inside a defensive covenant. Highreach, the presiding court of the Covenant of the Oath-Stone, holds the Frost Watch on the isle of Hoarfell by a covenant lease. Hoarfell belongs to Sealmoor, a small rich coastal kingdom, and is governed by its own Thing at Harbourmoot. Highreach's king says in open court that the isle should be held by Highreach; Sealmoor cannot fight him; Oathfold, the council of the remaining covenant courts, swore the same oath he did and depends on his fleets. Each seat receives injects each turn and issues decisions through a decision memo.
scenario.simulates: An alliance leader seizes a member's territory: the guarantor of a defensive pact coerces a small member for its far northern dependency, then occupies it from the watch-station it already holds there, and the remaining members must decide whether the pact binds against its own leader.

seats.name: Oathfold
seats.brief: You are the standing council of Oathfold, the covenant courts other than Highreach, presided over by the largest among you. You answer to your own kings, who do not agree. Your remit covers the courts' joint levies, the trade compact, the closing statute, and the corps of envoys. You have suspended the trade compact with Highreach and hold a statute that would shut every court's markets to it at once; no council has ever used it. Your contingents winter at Harbourmoot on the isle, three hundred men from five courts, sent as a sign and not as an army. Your own eastern frontier is guarded by Highreach's fleets and its watchers, and will be for five more years. An oath that does not bind the court that wrote it is not an oath; a court that says so aloud may find the fleets gone.
objectives: Uphold the oath-stone: the covenant must bind its presiding court
Keep Highreach's guarantee against the Khanate on the eastern frontier
Hold the courts of the council to one policy
Avoid becoming the belligerent in a war among covenant courts

seats.name: Sealmoor
seats.brief: You are the inner council of Sealmoor, a small and rich coastal kingdom, sovereign over the isle of Hoarfell. You answer to the queen. Your remit covers the fleet, the isle's garrison, the treasury, and diplomacy. Hoarfell is governed by its own Thing at Harbourmoot, which wants its own crown someday and yours for now; your garrison there numbers three hundred, six hundred with the covenant contingents, against the thousands Highreach can land from the Frost Watch and its fleet. You have spent a treasury on the northern defenses and said before every court that an attack by the presiding court on any member ends the covenant. You cannot win a fight with Highreach and you cannot be seen to decline one.
objectives: Keep Hoarfell under the crown and its own Thing
Hold the covenant courts to the oath they swore
Avoid a fight the isle's garrison cannot win
Keep the Thing from choosing Highreach over Sealmoor

turns.title: The Oath-Stone Summit
turns.inject: At the covenant's annual moot, before every court, Highreach's king says that Hoarfell 'should be held by Highreach, not by Sealmoor,' that the isle is 'very important to Highreach and not important to Sealmoor,' and that the Khanate will take it if he does not. turns.inject: The Thing at Harbourmoot votes fifteen to twelve to grant a Khanate merchant house a lease on the white-iron workings at the head of the northern fjord, over Sealmoor's objection, to pay for the independence it wants; a Khanate ship anchors to survey the site. turns.title: The Borrowed Road
turns.inject: Before dawn the Frost Watch marches. Its companies take the harbor at Harbourmoot, the Thing-hall, the beacon chain, and the fjord workings, 'at the invitation of the Thing' (the three bought members, and a fourth).
